kitEvidence.formula:
Jax enters a defensive stance for up to [2] seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking [25]% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After [2] seconds or Recasting, Jax deals [40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 + (0.7) × AP[statFormula=2]] + [4]% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for [1] second. 

The damage is increased by [20]% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of [(40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 + (0.7) × AP[statFormula=2]) × (2)] + [(4) × (2)]% max Health.

builds.name: Empower: W plus Grandmaster third hit
builds.summary: Investigate a high Empower and Grandmaster passive on one attack result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high Empower and Grandmaster passive on one attack result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 W contributes 190 + 0.6 AP magic; rank-3 R passive adds 185 + 0.6 AP on its qualifying third attack. Together they offer 375 + 1.2 AP magic before the separate physical attack and item on-hits. Nashor/Lich Bane are whole-event candidates, not multipliers on W or on the R passive.

builds.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms: five-target armor gain

builds.goal: Explore high armor granted by one five-champion Grandmaster activation output under the recorded finite setup, comparing item swaps rather than claiming an absolute maximum.
builds.hypothesis: At rank 3 the first champion grants 75 + 0.40 bonus AD armor, with 30 + 0.10 bonus AD per additional champion. Five legal targets nominally grant 195 + 0.80 bonus AD armor; granted MR is 60% of that helper.
